temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt with him over the past few days. When he asks if he upset her, Elizabeth says no, not at all; she is dealing with personal stuff and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith suspects Elizabeth may be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknowing mistake.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth denies being upset with him and explains that her curtness is due to personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not angry at him; her short responses are explained by personal issues she is facing.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved that he did not upset her, but concerned and sympathetic about her personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and supportive, and to let her know he is available if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers support and suggests a coffee break; Elizabeth thanks him, says it sounds good, and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress, not anger at him, and may need support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth responds positively to his offer and accepts his support/coffee invitation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth welcomes his support and is willing to spend a coffee break with him; he can help by being present and listening.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Sympathetic, hopeful, and pleased that she accepted.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Elizabeth during the coffee break and listen if she wants to share.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the coffee break, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe. Keith suggests talking to a professional; Elizabeth says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is under personal stress and is open to his support, but he does not yet know the severity or her view of professional help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her stresses appear severe, and he now thinks professional help might benefit her, while learning she is hesitant about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is facing serious stress; professional help could be useful for her, but she is uncertain, so he should avoid pressuring or offending her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and cautious about how his suggestion was received.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To remain supportive and respectful of her hesitation about professional help, without pushing too hard.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After his professional-help suggestion, Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn. When he apologizes for possibly overstepping, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is under serious stress and is hesitant about professional help; he is worried he may have overstepped by raising it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, partially. Her withdrawal makes him think his suggestion may have embarrassed her, but her response indicates she did not consider it overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth was not offended by his suggestion, but she is processing a lot and may have felt uncomfortable; his support is appreciated but should be handled gently.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and worried about having caused discomfort, though somewhat reassured by her words.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her, apologize if needed, avoid pushing, and make clear he is available as support without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative of Keith's concern. She thanks him, says it means a lot, and feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth appreciates his concern but may still be processing a lot; he is unsure how comfortable she now feels after the professional-help conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's openness and thanks confirm that she values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better knowing he is there; their supportive relationship is positive and helping her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain this supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks whenever she needs.
